why_this_workstream_and_not_promotion.reasoning: Every remaining promotion and certification step is credentialed or operator-owned: OD-1 (no actor in the worker system holds the shared database URL), OD-2 (database.read_census is Director-side by design), OD-3 (a 36-key vocabulary deletion is a product decision). None of them became executable this session. W-14 is the one item on the critical path that the accepted architecture already fully determines, and the assignment is explicit that remaining-plan work should continue rather than stop at the end of a worker list.
why_this_workstream_and_not_promotion.dependency_note: 03…:331 sequences W-13 → W-14. W-14's deliverable is a declaration MECHANISM and a pilot; it does not consume portal.access and is not blocked by D2/AD-2, which decides only which roles receive that grant. Building W-14 first also removes a stated blocker from W-13's own QA: W-13's tier A conformance is a lookup against this table.

measurements.file_grain_blind_spot_note: 751 handlers across 572 files. A file-grained table would assert one answer for an average of 1.31 handlers, and would be structurally unable to express the admin/users finding below.
measurements.plan_denominator_drift: sized at 539 routes, M2 amendment measured 559, 572 today — which is why RL-10's exit criterion is a property ('every route file appears') and not a count.

pilot_slice.basis: Every entry was read at the ENFORCER, not inferred from the route. The capability key came from the helper's own exported constant.
pilot_slice.reviewed_none: app/api/admin/ai/config-layout-assist/capabilities/route.ts GET — reports the caller's OWN capability booleans; gating a capability projection on the capability it projects would leave the UI unable to say what a user cannot do.

finding_the_method_grain_found_immediate.severity: MEDIUM — product decision, not a defect this workstream may fix
finding_the_method_grain_found_immediate.what: POST requires settings.users_roles via requireUsersRolesManageAuth (route.ts:69). GET requires only getAdminContextCached() (route.ts:23) — portal admission — and returns the full org member roster including every member's email address (route.ts:22-65).
finding_the_method_grain_found_immediate.why_it_matters: A file-grained census counts this file as capability-gated because POST is. This is exactly the weakness 05…§9 predicted, found on the first pass of the new grain, in the Users & Roles surface itself — the one surface whose whole purpose is managing access.
finding_the_method_grain_found_immediate.what_was_done: Declared 'pending' with the finding recorded inline. NOT declared 'none': asserting that roster read legitimately requires no capability is a product decision for W-15, and this workstream has no authority to give that answer.
finding_the_method_grain_found_immediate.not_escalated_because: It is a pre-existing behaviour, unchanged by this commit, and W-15 owns the remedy. It is recorded so the sweep cannot miss it.

w11_tier_a_check_now_expressible.plan_text: 03…§7: 'This check is only meaningful after W-14 supplies the declared set — so W-11 lands the data change and W-14 lands the check that keeps it true.'
w11_tier_a_check_now_expressible.status: LANDED. RL-10 joins every declared capability to discoverCatalog(). All 25 declared capabilities resolve to seeded catalog keys.
w11_tier_a_check_now_expressible.what_it_prevents: A route declaring a capability the catalog does not hold is a permanent 403 that reads like a gate — unsatisfiable by any grant.

They run against a temp copy — an earlier draft mutate-and-restored the committed table, which would have left the repository dirty if a run were killed mid-test.

The module parses and its top-level executes under vitest, so a syntax error would surface; the branch bodies would first execute in prebuild. `node` is not on this session's command allowlist.
verification.typecheck: NOT RUN — unchanged from the prior report. npm run typecheck cannot run on this host and gh is not permitted, so CI remains the only typecheck authority. The new TypeScript is one test file; the check itself is .mjs and outside the typecheck graph.
